value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of coordinatewise-monotone absolute norms for which *all* finite vertex-witness Čech filtrations admit product reconstruction. It identifies the smallest possible product witness and an exact degree-two persistent feature created although neither factor has positive-degree homology. This gives a sharp practical boundary for categorical product reductions and identifies a concrete nonfactorizable topological artifact, not an arbitrary isolated count.
